Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], an '''unidentified [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]]''' was being held as a criminal in the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] in the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He wore an [[Color/Legends|orange]] colored prison jumpsuit.

==Biography==
This Trandoshan was located in the detention facility's mess hall along with a fellow [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] prisoner when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], disguised as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], entered the room. He was later seen at the gym with the Rodian, helping him exercise.
Later on, when a prison riot ensued, the Trandoshan fought off the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] guards but was eventually stunned and captured.
